ownerDecisions.meaning: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › อำเภอ/เขต › อปท./ย่าน — the production hierarchy; outside Bangkok the finest level is the local administration (เทศบาล/อบต., DOLA code), inside Bangkok the CityMETER Locale (847 ย่าน)

ownerDecisions.choice: สาขากระจุกเทียบคน
ownerDecisions.meaning: share of the area's stores held by its top children against their share of residents, recomputed at every drill level; the map colours by store count with a switch to stores per 10,000 residents as in production

ownerDecisions.choice: download both folders the sheet references (brand and venue logos)
ownerDecisions.meaning: 17 brand files and 128 venue files, each verified by sha256 against the sheet before use

items: analytical neighborhood cores → production administrative hierarchy (js/hierarchy.js); no area, boundary or id is invented
first Aha: share of distinct brands in 3 neighborhoods → share of stores in the top-k children vs their share of residents, at every level
choropleth: count equal-interval → count or density.capita quantile classes with an on-map metric switch
pins: every row a WebGL dot (js/stores-layer.js); HTML pins with logos only from zoom 14 inside the focus
host buildings, venue x-ray and the eye preset removed (no venue is a confirmed host of a store); city massing kept, rounded focus massing only for compact local units
province frames: OpenGISData-Thailand (9) → production boundaries of all 77 provinces; districts and units loaded per province
charts: ranking/mix/compare → paired stores-vs-people ranking (or per-capita), store-type matrix, brand matrix
status: one honest status for every row (อยู่ในรายการสาขาของแบรนด์); no closure taxonomy in this dataset
pictogram subset re-cut with 9 glyphs (npm material-symbols 0.27.0)
venue logos: 128 files for 2,547 venue names (mostly shared operator banners, role caption shown)

hierarchyContract.module: js/hierarchy.js (NO_SELECTION, normalizeSelection, levelOf, CHILD_LEVEL, areaRows, childrenOf, summarizeChildren, rankChildren, ahaSize, buildAha, buildUnitInsight, levelNouns, areaKey)

levels.name: จังหวัด
levels.children: its districts (อำเภอ; เขต in Bangkok)

levels.name: อำเภอ / เขต
levels.children: the local units whose parent is that district (อปท.; ย่าน in Bangkok)

levels.name: อปท. / ย่าน
levels.kinds: 7,774 local administrations (DOLA code; prefix ทน./ทม./ทต./อบต./เมืองพัทยา) + 847 Bangkok Locales (uuid)

hierarchyContract.selection: {province, district, unit} as indexes (-1 = none); a unit implies its district and province (normalizeSelection)

keys.province: production abbreviation (BKK, CBI …); the 2-digit code also resolves
keys.store: first 8 hex characters of the source uuid (unique, asserted by build-data.py)
keys.venue: GV-… id from the sheet tab 07_VENUES

membership.district: source subdistrict membership (sheet district_code, from the SUBDISTRICT tile the row came in) — sums equal the API for 927 of 928 districts
membership.unit: production overlay membership (grocery/overlayMvt inTileType MUNICIPALITY | LOCALE) — equals the API for all 5,692 units with stores
membership.twoUnits: 15 stores sit in two overlapping units and count in both, as in production; the Aha share counts each store once
membership.outsideUnits: 19 Bangkok stores lie outside every Locale (13 in ดุสิต); their finest level is the district
membership.unitParent: DOLA code digits (7,774), majority of a Locale's stores within Bangkok (681), largest overlap for Locales without stores (166)
membership.districtMismatch: 69 stores carry a subdistrict district other than their unit's parent (25 units straddle a district border, e.g. ทน.แหลมฉบัง 152 members, 130 in ศรีราชา). Rule: an area's count is the same everywhere — a district counts by subdistrict (= API), a unit counts all its production members (= API), also inside its district's comparison (hierarchy.js#comparisonRows); shares of a district (Aha numerator, ranking storeShare) count only the district's own stores (summarizeChildren inArea), so a numerator never takes stores outside its denominator

hierarchyContract.children: summarizeChildren returns every child, including measured zeros, with count, distinct brands, population and stores per 10,000; rankChildren sorts by the metric, then count, then Thai name, then key
hierarchyContract.nouns: levelNouns: country → จังหวัด / ประเทศ; province → อำเภอ (เขต in Bangkok) / จังหวัด; district → อปท. (ย่าน in Bangkok) / อำเภอ; an abbreviated noun takes a space (js/model.js#withNoun → ‘ดูทุก อปท.’)

firstAha.scope: filtered rows of the current area (country, province or district); recomputed for every filter and selection
firstAha.ranking: children by store count, then Thai name, then key; k = 3 with ≥ 9 children, 2 with ≥ 4, else 1; only children with stores
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของสาขา[ใน{areaName}]อยู่ใน[ {k} ]{childNoun}นี้
firstAha.comparisonTemplate: ซึ่งมีคน[แค่] {popShare}% ของ{areaNoun}
firstAha.numerator: stores of the current area that belong to any of the k children (union — a store in two units counts once)
firstAha.denominator: all stores of the current area in the filter

populationComparison.rule: popShare = population of the k children ÷ population of all children of the current area, shown only when every child has a registered population
populationComparison.missing: any child without population → ‘ยังไม่มีข้อมูลประชากรครบทุก… จึงไม่เทียบกับจำนวนคน’; never estimated
populationComparison.source: registered population (ทะเบียนราษฎร พ.ค. 2569) as used by CityMETER

firstAha.action: ดูทุก{childNoun} (clears auto focus → ?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบ{childNoun} (opens the chart tray); area names in the Aha are drill-down buttons
firstAha.explicitAction: โฟกัส {k} {childNoun}นี้ (shown when focus mode is none)

invariants.rule: One source row owns one dot (and one pin from zoom 14); no clustering, aggregation or moved coordinates — context dots included
450 pins and 250 logos are ceilings, never quotas; pins and logos only at zoom ≥ 14 and only for rows in focus
Preserve original logo artwork (verified bytes, outer whitespace cropped only); backplates follow the measured artwork
The first Aha compares the share of stores with the share of residents of the same children; it is recomputed for every level and filter and never hard-coded
Never sum distinct brands across areas; the Aha numerator is a union (a store in two units counts once)
Membership comes from production (subdistrict for district, overlay for unit); the demo never assigns a store to an area by its own point-in-polygon
Never invent an area, boundary, population or id; production codes are the keys
Missing population is no data, never zero; a comparison that needs it is omitted, not estimated
Analytical colours keep the approved LDS HEX on both themes (count, density.capita); contrast is solved with ink, outlines and backplates, never by recolouring data
Classes are computed on display-rounded values; the legend states the metric and its denominator; measured_zero ≠ no_data ≠ out_of_scope
Detail only for the focused part; everything else stays visible but quiet (outline-only areas, quiet labels, grey dots without logos and outside the tab order)
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of the UI; provenance, limits and status live in the store facts, help and docs
Status is ‘อยู่ในรายการสาขาของแบรนด์’ — never ‘open’; no closure is invented
No CSV download UI
No decorative bracket or coloured left rail; visible focus on every control
Basemap and massing colours come only from --basemap-* tokens; massing is OSM context and never encodes a metric
Breadcrumb levels are ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › อำเภอ/เขต › อปท./ย่าน › สถานที่; a store is never a crumb; production links go out, never in
Matrix cells are equal in size; only the number and its class carry meaning
The population bar of the ranking is neutral (never a data colour) and always labelled
Camera presets never move or scale data; every 3D preset keeps the horizon outside the frame
A venue is a name a branch refers to — never say a store is inside it; the venue name stays the identity and shared marks carry their role
Pictograms are decorative: every tile and heading keeps its text label; the nav-7 subset stays byte-identical and the pictogram subset is a declared test exception
The core panel, Aha, charts and table work without the map; every optional resource (map library, tiles, boundaries, store details, logos) fails soft with a retry or a quiet fallback
